description: Defines the NumberValue class used to represent DynamoDB Number (N) attribute values, encapsulating a number as a string and providing serialization and string conversion methods.

classes.name: NumberValue
classes.description: A class to represent a DynamoDB Number (N) value, supporting JSON serialization and string conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NumberValue with a string, integer, or float value and stores it as a string.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the number for JSON serialization.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the number.
